en.Auto-record when a meeting app opens: Auto-record when a meeting app opens
en.Recording from %@. Notes will be ready w: Recording from %@. Notes will be ready when the meeting ends.
en.Start your first meeting from the menu b: Start your first meeting from the menu bar. Everything stays on this Mac.
en.Privacy body: KinetMinutes runs entirely on your Mac. Recording, transcription and summarization all happen locally. Your audio and notes never leave this computer — the app makes no server calls.
en.Data location body: Audio, transcripts and notes are stored under ~/Library/Containers/com.kinet.minutes.app/. You can delete everything at any time.
en.This permanently removes all recordings,: This permanently removes all recordings, transcripts and notes on this Mac. This cannot be undone.
en.Choose a transcription model in Settings: Choose a transcription model in Settings to enable notes.
en.Speaker: Speaker
en.You've used all %d free notes this month: You've used all %d free notes this month. Upgrade to Pro for unlimited notes.
en.Recording from %@. Transcript will be re: Recording from %@. Transcript will be ready when the recording ends.
en.Transcript saved. Generate AI notes anyt: Transcript saved. Generate AI notes anytime from the meeting.
en.Mode hint: New recordings start in this mode. Transcript-only is free and unlimited; AI notes use your monthly quota.
en.Model hint: Used for on-device transcription. Larger is more accurate; changes apply to the next recording.
en.Quota hint: A meeting counts once after its AI notes are generated. Upgrade to Pro for unlimited.
en.Endpoint hint: For mainland China, use https://hf-mirror.com to download models.
en.%@ of recording audio will be deleted. N: %@ of recording audio will be deleted. Notes and transcripts are kept.

en.Pick a meeting on the left, or start rec: Pick a meeting on the left, or start recording from the menu bar.

ko.Recording from %@. Notes will be ready w: %@에서 녹음 중입니다. 회의가 끝나면 회의록이 준비됩니다.
ko.Start your first meeting from the menu b: 메뉴 막대에서 첫 회의를 시작하세요. 모든 데이터는 이 Mac에 남습니다.
ko.Privacy body: KinetMinutes는 전적으로 이 Mac에서 실행됩니다. 녹음, 받아쓰기, 요약이 모두 로컬에서 이루어지며 오디오와 회의록은 이 컴퓨터를 떠나지 않습니다. 앱은 서버를 호출하지 않습니다.
ko.Data location body: 오디오, 받아쓰기, 회의록은 ~/Library/Containers/com.kinet.minutes.app/에 저장됩니다. 언제든지 모두 삭제할 수 있습니다.
ko.This permanently removes all recordings,: 이 Mac의 모든 녹음, 받아쓰기, 회의록을 영구적으로 삭제합니다. 되돌릴 수 없습니다.
ko.Choose a transcription model in Settings: 설정에서 받아쓰기 모델을 선택하면 회의록을 사용할 수 있습니다.
ko.Speaker: 발화자
ko.You've used all %d free notes this month: 이번 달 무료 회의록 %d회를 모두 사용했습니다. Pro로 업그레이드하면 무제한으로 사용할 수 있습니다.
ko.Recording from %@. Transcript will be re: %@에서 녹음 중입니다. 녹음이 끝나면 받아쓰기가 준비됩니다.

ko.Mode hint: 새 녹음은 이 모드로 시작합니다. 받아쓰기만은 무료·무제한이며 AI 회의록은 월간 할당량을 사용합니다.
ko.Model hint: 온디바이스 받아쓰기에 사용됩니다. 모델이 클수록 정확하며 변경 사항은 다음 녹음부터 적용됩니다.
ko.Quota hint: AI 회의록을 생성한 회의가 1회로 집계됩니다. Pro는 무제한입니다.
ko.Endpoint hint: 중국 본토에서는 https://hf-mirror.com을 사용해 모델을 다운로드하세요.
ko.%@ of recording audio will be deleted. N: 녹음 오디오 %@가 삭제됩니다. 회의록과 받아쓰기는 유지됩니다.
ko.The interface language changes after you: KinetMinutes를 종료하고 다시 열면 인터페이스 언어가 변경됩니다.

ko.Pick a meeting on the left, or start rec: 왼쪽에서 회의를 선택하거나 메뉴 막대에서 녹음을 시작하세요.

fr.Auto-record when a meeting app opens: Enregistrer automatiquement à l'ouverture d'une app de réunion
fr.Recording from %@. Notes will be ready w: Enregistrement de %@. Les notes seront prêtes à la fin de la réunion.
fr.Start your first meeting from the menu b: Démarrez votre première réunion depuis la barre des menus. Tout reste sur ce Mac.
fr.Notes generation failed: Échec de la génération des notes
fr.Privacy body: KinetMinutes fonctionne entièrement sur votre Mac. L'enregistrement, la transcription et le résumé se font en local. Votre audio et vos notes ne quittent jamais cet ordinateur — l'app n'effectue aucun appel serveur.
fr.Data location body: L'audio, les transcriptions et les notes sont stockés sous ~/Library/Containers/com.kinet.minutes.app/. Vous pouvez tout supprimer à tout moment.
fr.This permanently removes all recordings,: Cela supprime définitivement tous les enregistrements, transcriptions et notes de ce Mac. Action irréversible.
fr.Choose a transcription model in Settings: Choisissez un modèle de transcription dans les Réglages pour activer les notes.
fr.Speaker: Intervenant
fr.You've used all %d free notes this month: Vous avez utilisé vos %d notes gratuites ce mois-ci. Passez à Pro pour des notes illimitées.
fr.Recording from %@. Transcript will be re: Enregistrement de %@. La transcription sera prête à la fin de l'enregistrement.
fr.Transcript saved. Generate AI notes anyt: Transcription enregistrée. Générez des notes IA à tout moment depuis la réunion.
fr.Mode hint: Les nouveaux enregistrements démarrent dans ce mode. La transcription seule est gratuite et illimitée ; les notes IA utilisent votre quota mensuel.
fr.Model hint: Utilisé pour la transcription sur l'appareil. Plus le modèle est grand, plus il est précis ; le changement s'applique au prochain enregistrement.
fr.Quota hint: Une réunion compte une fois ses notes IA générées. Passez à Pro pour un usage illimité.
fr.Endpoint hint: En Chine continentale, utilisez https://hf-mirror.com pour télécharger les modèles.
fr.%@ of recording audio will be deleted. N: %@ d'audio d'enregistrement seront supprimés. Les notes et transcriptions sont conservées.
fr.The interface language changes after you: La langue de l'interface change après avoir quitté et rouvert KinetMinutes.
fr.no stats yet: Aucune réunion pour l'instant — les statistiques apparaîtront après votre premier enregistrement.
fr.Prefill title from calendar: Préremplir le titre depuis le calendrier
fr.Purchase could not be verified: L'achat n'a pas pu être vérifié
fr.Pick a meeting on the left, or start rec: Choisissez une réunion à gauche ou démarrez un enregistrement depuis la barre des menus.

de.Pick a meeting on the left, or start rec: Wählen Sie links eine Besprechung oder starten Sie eine Aufnahme über die Menüleiste.
